title: Jeppe sur la Monto; aŭ la Transformita Kamparano
summary: "Jeppe sur la Monto; aŭ la Transformita Kamparano" by Ludvig Holberg is a Danish comedy written in 1722. A drunken peasant named Jeppe, tormented by his wife and trapped in misery, becomes the target of an elaborate prank. When a baron discovers him unconscious, he transports Jeppe to his castle and convinces him he's a nobleman.
